name: Volcán, Panama

rent.notes: Guides put 2BR houses at $500 to $900 and 3BR at $750 to $1,200. Encuentra24 furnished 2-3BR listings run $950 to $1,400. Few listings state a pet policy.

groceries.notes: Couple groceries are $300 to $400 a month. A 100 lb dog eats about 15 kg of kibble a month, roughly $55 to $100 depending on brand. A 2022 Pedigree price was used as the floor.

utilities.notes: Electricity runs $15 to $60 with no air conditioning, water about $5, and 25 lb propane tanks $5 to $8. The colder climate may add propane for hot water. Internet is excluded.

healthcare.notes: Private health insurance premiums for two adults age 60-61. Min is two Family Medical Plan memberships ($117.30 each, ages 60-69); typical and max reflect 2026 local quotes of $6,000-10,000/yr for a couple age 60. Premiums are national and age-rated. Pensionado discounts apply to services, not premiums.

insurance.notes: Re-modeled to renters/contents insurance only. The old $150 to $400 was health insurance. No local quote was found, so this uses the Boquete model value.

petDaycare.notes: Boarding is $10 to $30 a night nationally. Volcan has few dedicated kennels, so informal sitters are likely.

sources.title: Relofirm: pets in Panama costs

petGrooming.notes: Full-service grooming is $20 to $40 nationally. A large double-coated dog sits at the upper end.

sources.title: Relofirm: pets in Panama costs

transportation.notes: David is 45 to 60 minutes away, so weekly trips for specialists and big shopping add fuel. Modeled: about 800 km a month at about $1.16/L, insurance at $500 to $900 a year, plus maintenance. A taxi to David is $35 to $40; the bus is $2 to $3.

entertainment.notes: +Movil is rolling out symmetric FTTH in Volcan, and Tigo 250 Mbps fiber is about $45. A nice dinner for two is $15 to $25, so four a month plus fonda lunches, streaming and local activities.
